svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Tollgate in context
svg.desc: An isometric system context. You ask your Claude Code session for a change and answer its questions. Tollgate, on your machine, gives the session the next step and takes each role's answer. The roles run on the AI model: through your session in session mode, or started by Tollgate in background mode. The model is the only outside service Tollgate calls. GitHub, gray because it is not part of Tollgate, is where you install the plugin from and where your push goes, after Tollgate's checks pass.
svg.text: who and what it talks to
gates and merges, on your machine
